articles.summary: From GGV Capital, Evolving for the Next Billion podcast interviews local champions and global giants who are reshaping the lives of the next billion internet users. On this episode, GGV Capital Managing Partner Hans Tung sits down with Odeko CEO and Founder Dane Atkinson to discuss his career, the impact of technology
articles.title: Odeko’s CEO Dane Atkinson on Supporting Small Businesses Through Technology
